name: Harbor Medical Inc
label: Strong
reasons: 3 different insiders bought within 30 days — clusters are the strongest version of this signal
The CEO is among the buyers — top executives' buys carry the most information
Biggest stake increase: +150% of what that insider already held — a real commitment, not a token buy

take.headline: This is the pattern with the best track record: several insiders buying on the open market.
take.body: Studies of this setup show modest average outperformance over the following 6–12 months, with wide dispersion — most names drift, a few carry the result. People who use it treat each alert as one position in a basket of many, sized small, held for months, and never as a reason to buy options or go all-in.
take.studied_edge: a few % over the market, on average, per year
